description: Make the checks a precondition of both deploys. Each deploy workflow calls the check workflow as a reusable workflow and depends on it, so the gate runs against the exact commit being released. Branch protection was rejected: it blocks merges, but the deploy fires on the push that results from a merge and cannot cover a direct push.
expectedBehavior: The check workflow is callable by another workflow and runs on pull requests
Each deploy job depends on the check job and is skipped when checks fail
A green commit on a deploy branch still deploys
A push to a branch with no open pull request no longer runs the full matrix
verificationSteps: On a throwaway branch wired like a deploy branch, push a commit that fails a check and confirm the deploy job is skipped rather than run
Push a green commit to develop and confirm staging deploys
Confirm a push to a feature branch with no open pull request runs no checks
